text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the shrine together with Seeking 
the Pearl, who hasn't been in top form 
lately.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. The reason I came here today wasn't 
to make a wish to God—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I came to make God happy!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"God must be exhausted from always 
listening to wishes. So—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: I'll heal everyone with my dancing!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Come on, Trainer, join in!! Together, 
we're going to thrill the gods 
themselves...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I ended up having to dance 
together with Seeking the Pearl, but—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Nice!! Your sharpness is just 
getting better and better!!!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"Could the gods be singing in unison?! Or 
perhaps—"

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The blessings of gratitude... are real?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohohoho! Let's pump up the beat even 
moreee!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Whether it was a divine blessing or not 
remains uncertain... but Seeking the Pearl 
regained her top form after that.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Guh... To think our dance wasn't enough to 
heal everyone...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her passion failed to reach the heavens, 
and she was unable to recover her 
condition.
